entries.name: PLAYER_ANIM_RUN
entries.reason: The packed run entry ends immediately before the separately named landing-response root at 0x00122080.

entries.name: PLAYER_ANIM_JUMP
entries.reason: The opening frames and F4 gate occupy the eight-byte prelude; the selected terrain-launch response begins at 0x001221B8.

entries.name: PLAYER_ANIM_THROW_APPLE
entries.reason: The root's conditional branches converge on the local response body and dynamic F8 handoff immediately before the next action stream at 0x00122470.

entries.name: PLAYER_ANIM_SWORD
entries.reason: The root's field-gated paths converge on the sound/dynamic-selector body before the distinct 0x001227B0 sword-response continuation.

entries.name: PLAYER_ANIM_SWORD_RESPONSE
entries.reason: The branch target contains the 0x07AA/0x0A76/0x0A72 response sequence, sound 0x21, timer reload, and F8 handoff before the Type-0x1E response root.

entries.name: PLAYER_ANIM_BRAKE
entries.reason: The player selector enters at 0x001232E0, eight bytes into the already bounded Type-0x84 transition presentation stream.

conclusion: The player selector roots are now distinguished from their separately entered/shared continuation streams, while the brake entry is represented as an alias rather than a competing ROM range.
